reviews.title: The Ultimate Silent Powerhouse for AMD Enthusiasts
reviews.comment: The ASRock AMD Radeon RX 7900 XT Phantom Gaming 20GB OC Graphics Card is a powerhouse designed for gamers seeking high performance and quiet operation. With its advanced features and compatibility with high-end AMD processors, this GPU stands out in the competitive landscape of graphics cards. -------------------------------------------- *** Performance and Compatibility *** -------------------------------------------- One of the most compelling aspects of the RX 7900 XT is its AMD-on-AMD synergy, particularly when paired with high-end AMD processors (I'm using an AMD Ryzen Threadripper PRO, could not get Nvidia RTX A4000/A5000 to work with multiple DP monitors connected - caused mouse lag and hesitation). This combination leverages Smart Access Memory (SAM), which optimizes data transfer between the CPU and GPU, resulting in enhanced performance in gaming and compute tasks. You will notice improvements in frame rates and responsiveness when using an all-AMD setup, making this card an ideal choice for those already invested in AMD technology. The RX 7900 XT features 84 RDNA 3 Compute Units and 5,376 stream processors, allowing it to handle demanding games at resolutions up to 7680 x 4320 (8K) with ease. Its factory-overclocked settings boost the GPU clock speeds up to 2,450 MHz, ensuring that it delivers exceptional performance across various gaming scenarios. In benchmarks, it consistently achieves 60 FPS or higher at both 1440p and 4K resolutions, making it a future-proof option for gamers looking to play the latest titles. -------------------------------------------- *** Silent Cooling and Build Quality *** -------------------------------------------- The 0dB Silent Cooling feature is another highlight of the ASRock RX 7900 XT Phantom Gaming card. Thanks to its Phantom Gaming 3X Cooling System, which includes three striped ring fans, this graphics card operates quietly even under heavy loads. The design not only enhances cooling efficiency but also ensures that gamers can enjoy immersive experiences without intrusive noise. This is particularly beneficial for users who prioritize a quiet gaming environment or those who use their systems for content creation alongside gaming. -------------------------------------------- ***  Technical Specifications *** -------------------------------------------- | Feature | Specification| |--------------------------| | Release Date| Nov 3rd, 2022 | | Base Clock | 1567 MHz | | Game Clock | 2075 MHz | | Boost Clock | 2450 MHz | | Memory | 20GB GDDR6 | | Memory Bus | 320-bit | | Memory Speed | 20 Gbps | | Bus Interface | PCIe 4.0 x16 | | Total Board Power (TBP) | ~315W | | Recommended PSU | Minimum 750W; ideally 850W or higher | | Power Connector | 2 x 8-pin | | Display Outputs | 3 x DisplayPort™ 2.1, 1 x HDMI™ 2.1 | | DirectX Support | DirectX 12 Ultimate | | LxWxH | 13x5.5x2.3 inches | -------------------------------------------- ***  Conclusion *** -------------------------------------------- In summary, the ASRock AMD Radeon RX 7900 XT Phantom Gaming OC Graphics Card excels in delivering high-performance gaming experiences while maintaining a quiet operation. Its compatibility with high-end AMD processors enhances its appeal for gamers looking for an optimized system. With robust specifications and advanced cooling technology, this graphics card is a solid investment for anyone serious about gaming at high resolutions. Whether you are playing the latest AAA titles or engaging in resource-intensive tasks, the RX 7900 XT is sure to meet and exceed expectations.

reviews.title: Best price to Performance high-end GPU, Don't be an fanboy excise your options
reviews.comment: I was looking for an upgrade from my RTX 3060 and I've looked at alot of benchmarks and reviews of the AMD 7900XT and I was a bit unsure because so many people would say how bad they were and originally i wanted an RTX 4080 super but 1000$ felt like an scam to pay that price just for 16 GB vram , so I went in optimistic and hopeful and honestly if someone was looking for vale I would recommend AMD because they don't limit vram on there GPUs if you're gonna pay 1000 dollars for an RTX 4080 it should at least have 20GB of vram like RX 7900XT so I got 7900XT for future proofing my PC and I did not care about raytracing because even on an Nvidia card it tanks performance too the point you have to use upscaling,mind you I did try raytracing on the 7900XT it is capable of it but not the best also I did have an driver with fortnite dx12 which would have been a deal breaker for me but I don't play fortnite I did try it again it works perfectly now I was experiencing low fps but I had to turn of nanite once I did that I got the fps I was hoping to get but so far it has been able to run every game I threw at it at max settings in 1440p and 4k and I will say this is a solid GPU for maxed out setting at 1440p and 4k gaming for 700 bucks and it beats the RTX 4070 super ti and is on par with the rtx 4080 and this is my own honest review from someone who is not an fanboy of any gpu brands this review is to tell people to Excise there options don't just select a brand because you like the brand select value to Performance BTW I still prefer team Green but team red is pretty good and has an better app than nvidia plus the card is good for productivity  AMD AV1 encoding stream is actually pretty decent in obs.

reviews.title: 4k gaming with no compromises
reviews.comment: 9 years ago I bought a 4k monitor. I knew the day would eventually come that I would be able to run games at 4k. Paired with an R7 5800X, 32gb ddr4 3200mhz, and an 850 watt power supply to feed this beast. I can finally run 4k 60fps max settings in every game I've tried. Hell divers 2, gta 5, far cry, halo, phantom pain, ect. Enable AMD SAM and you'll see a solid uptick in performance, but more importantly performance stability. I don't get stuttering, or frame dips. I enable vsync and my fps stays steady at 60. I've never had that even at lower resolution. This card is worth it. If you're on DDR4 still, upgrade your AM4 socket chip to a R7 5800x or 3dxd. It's a beast for the value, and you'll be getting more from your system.
